title.value: Screen resumes and run AI voice interviews for candidates

introduction.value: An open-source agent uses Claude to score PDF resumes 0-100, phones candidates scoring 60+ via Vapi for 4 structured questions, then scores transcripts and ranks candidates.

method.value: Django sends each uploaded PDF resume to Claude as a base64 document, with no parser. Claude returns a score and recommendation. For candidates scoring 60 or higher, Django triggers a Vapi outbound call. Vapi calls a custom Claude endpoint, and Claude asks four questions and ends the call with an end_call tool. A webhook then delivers the transcript for scoring.

outcome.value: Screening takes under 5 seconds per resume, and an interview takes about 5 minutes. Scores of 75 or more are shortlisted and under 50 are rejected. Scores from 50 to 75 need a human decision. The post presents it as a v1 and gives no hiring outcomes.

notes.value: The author estimates about $50/month for a small team (Claude API, Vapi calls, a small server). Voice calls need the backend exposed publicly, for example through ngrok.

source_text.body:
Screen resumes and run AI voice interviews for candidates
An open-source agent uses Claude to score PDF resumes 0-100, phones candidates scoring 60+ via Vapi for 4 structured questions, then scores transcripts and ranks candidates.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
Django sends each uploaded PDF resume to Claude as a base64 document, with no parser. Claude returns a score and recommendation. For candidates scoring 60 or higher, Django triggers a Vapi outbound call. Vapi calls a custom Claude endpoint, and Claude asks four questions and ends the call with an end_call tool. A webhook then delivers the transcript for scoring.
How it went
Screening takes under 5 seconds per resume, and an interview takes about 5 minutes. Scores of 75 or more are shortlisted and under 50 are rejected. Scores from 50 to 75 need a human decision. The post presents it as a v1 and gives no hiring outcomes.
Worth knowing
The author estimates about $50/month for a small team (Claude API, Vapi calls, a small server). Voice calls need the backend exposed publicly, for example through ngrok.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Build me a small script that screens resumes for the [job title] role. It should read every PDF in [folder path], score each resume 0-100 against these requirements: [list of must-haves and nice-to-haves], and write a ranked CSV with the score and a one-sentence reason for each. You are done when the CSV exists and I've reviewed the top 10; do not contact any candidate, and pause and show me the list before any step that would call or message someone.
Original source: https://codewithmuh.com/blog/i-built-an-ai-hiring-agent-that-screens-resumes-and-conducts-voice-interviews
